status: Prospective semantic checks; T69 validates authored fixtures only, no production host implementation
pydantic_v2_mapping: All object models: ConfigDict(extra='forbid', frozen=True, strict=True); Literal contract/role/status enums; constrained SHA256/aliases; required explicit nullable fields; list bounds as schemas. Cross-field/source rules below require model_validator(mode='after') and host registry lookups. Do not silently coerce/normalize returned quote text. These are typed design requirements, not Python model implementation.
hash_encoding: Text hashes use exact UTF-8 bytes. packet_sha256 hashes canonical payload JSON only: sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False; its own field is excluded. JSON object/resource/projection/request hashes use that same canonical encoding unless explicitly a file-byte hash. Hash referenced image bytes, not base64 spelling. Freeze actual provider request bytes separately before send, including prompt/schema/messages/image payload identity.
identity_and_layers: Aliases unique per packet; one-to-one paragraph_alias to source_id; allowed target/context sets and source order frozen. Specialize per-request alias/role/unit enums without mutating generic draft schemas.

Recompute every original/static/saved-proposal text hash, packet hash, image byte hash and referenced rule/resource/schema/prompt/code/model identity. Replay saved ordered nonoverlapping expected-text edits from raw to each layer; unchanged portions retain exact raw support. No unbound derived layer, implicit current-file replacement or silent legacy migration.

Target/static sums <=6000codepoints each and context sums<=2000each under preserved T60 source-size bounds, not6000per paragraph. At most32paragraphs and1image/7bindings across the chunk; total image bytes<=16MiB. An incomplete draft may contain image=null or diagnostics not_run but is never launch-ready.

An image target binding must reference the exact source raw hash and whole nonempty raw interval [0,len(raw)); crop geometry must be positive, inside actual crop dimensions, derived from verified source geometry/registration and cover each target. Host-verified bytes/geometry and legibility are prerequisites. A model's clear label cannot override a wrong image/source binding.

Registration/legibility status words are not sufficient proof. Resolve the frozen image binding and registration evidence records by their actual file/record hashes; require matching item/leaf/hOCR/page-map identities and raw target coverage. Recompute referenced evidence identity against verified registry/cache bytes. Missing proof, wrong source identity or unverified geometry blocks dispatch even if status says verified/checked.

diagnostics frozen means detector/config/resource identities known, each signal raw quote/span replay matches, and each target either has signals or is explicitly detector-negative. not_run requires detector/config hashes null, signals empty and negative_targets empty. Word/name/number verification routes and static confidence are not proof of correctness.

audit_saved_proposal requires a hash-bound saved proposal for every target, with prior request/raw-reply identities and replayable original support. Other roles forbid saved_proposal. Preserve the exact old result and review state; do not salvage old invalid artifacts. Context is available evidence, never an editable/scored target.

Full proposed text is capped at6000codepoints per target in the draft shape; host aggregate/input/output token limits can be stricter. Overflow blocks or invalidates an attempt; no truncated full-reading success claim.
provider_projection: Default role productive_repair_and_self_check receives frozen image/raw/static edits/diagnostics and exact target/context geometry through provider-input-v2 only; no hidden prior response, human expected answer, fixture oracle or model grade.
audit_saved_proposal requires the exact hash-bound saved result and excludes new repair readings/patches. No image-only role is dispatched by default. Context must never become a target.
inspection_and_states: Use original status semantics plus full_reading_replay rules above; no valid_observation outcome in default v2. Per-target uncertainty must be supported and cannot be treated as a verified transcription.
exact_source_binding: scope=quote requires nonnull nonblank raw_quote; scope=whole_paragraph requires raw_quote=null. Only declared target paragraphs may anchor findings/patches. A quote must occur exactly once in its declared original raw paragraph, counting overlapping matches. No case/Unicode/whitespace normalization, fuzzy search, first-occurrence selection, coordinate guessing or repair of a failed old reply.

Finding/patch reply quotes contain no source hash: host resolves aliases only through frozen input raw/source/image hashes and emits them explicitly. Wrong or changed input hashes cannot be repaired by a model echo. Model-authored start/end fields are forbidden. Whole-paragraph anchors derive [0,len(raw)) and can express uncertainty about missing text without inventing a precise location; whole-paragraph support alone cannot authorize a replacement patch.

For affected_layer=raw, affected_quote must equal the precise raw anchor quote; for a whole-paragraph finding it may be null. For static/saved_proposal, affected_quote must uniquely occur in that frozen layer, and its inverse edit map must lie within the declared raw anchor support. Record layer start/end/hash and original supporting span separately. A null derived affected_quote is allowed only for unresolved whole-paragraph uncertainty. No ordinal/dangling edit reference substitutes for actual text support.

Patch raw_quote must bind uniquely, lie within its linked proposed finding's original support, name the same paragraph/image, differ from replacement, and not overlap another patch or unresolved source concern. Exact deletion is permitted; zero-width insertion is not. Host sorts bound patches by frozen source order/raw start, then reuses existing replay checks; never moves text across paragraphs. Applying to static coordinates, unsupported cross-record relocation or changing accepted ledgers is forbidden.

Preserve original reply string, parsed model proposal, host-derived positions, raw/derived maps, uncertainty and comparison disagreements separately. A finding about a harmful static or saved edit is a proposal, not a reversal of the immutable saved layer. New derived text is reconstructed from raw and only supported patch proposals; unchanged targets retain raw text. No patch to a different target may resolve a source ambiguity.
journaling_and_recovery: Reuse existing request claim before transport and raw reply/usage persistence before parsing; new contract and payload/projection/request/schema/prompt/code/model/image/diagnostic/sampling/budget hashes are run/task identities. No task expansion in an old journal and no migration/repair of terminal legacy results.

Before-send durable intent, after-send ambiguous state, saved-raw-before-validation and terminal-export checkpoints need fresh-process fake-provider proof in T53. Reuse identical compatible terminal results with zero sends. An in-flight unknown outcome or unknown budget/usage blocks all new requests; never assume timeout means not executed.

HR-011/T68 default has7slots/cumulative840request seconds plus360planned setup/report within1800whole-session seconds,120percall,zero retries and1shared-lock request. Revised bounds.json ceilings apply; spare time never permits extra calls. Actual token/image fit, exact provider/model compatibility, fresh process/queue/log/lock checks and authorized readiness remain T55/T56, not supplied by these schemas.

Client deadline is not backend cancellation proof. T53/T55 must define owned-request stopping and subsequent observation. On ambiguity do not launch next slot, stop/reconcile and retain unknown server cost. New study chunks have separate finite manifests and cumulative consumption; no reset, automatic replay or recurring chain.
host_export: Preserve exact v2 input/request/raw reply/model/schema/prompt/source/image identities, all attempted usage/unknowns and host semantic outcomes; never reinterpret v1 journals under v2.
Expose full proposed readings only as unreviewed AI evidence after source binding/replay checks. Store validation and image-quality outcomes separately; no accepted-ledger mutation.
full_reading_replay: Exactly one target_reading per declared target for productive role, none for context; no missing, duplicate or foreign aliases. audit_saved_proposal requires target_readings=[] and patches=[].

For findings/no_finding: every target fully inspected with suitable registered image, reading nonblank/non-null; reading_status proposed iff that target has patches, otherwise unchanged. Complete self-check coverage and all nine checked_content categories required per target for a claimed full inspection; these are model claims, not image truth.

Resolve unique raw quotes, link each patch to a same-target proposed visible-print finding, reject overlap/no-op and unsupported/foreign aliases. Replay all patches from exact raw, not static; require byte-for-byte equality with proposed_text. No hidden normalization or unsupported insertions, including after target endpoint.

incomplete/unresolved requires explanatory reason, patches=[], every productive target_reading withheld with proposed_text=null and reason. Preserve findings/uncertainties without exposing partial text as an accepted reading. audit role remains readings-free.

No_finding requires empty findings/patches, exact unchanged raw reading, complete inspections and self-check, no remaining concerns or uncertainties. findings requires at least one finding; unresolved findings or unsuitable image force unresolved rather than pretending success.

A structural replay pass cannot detect all image-reading errors. A response that repairs only GCO and faithfully leaves Tlie in its full reading can be structurally valid yet fail an independent/constructed-print quality check. Keep these two outcomes separate; never score a host-valid reply as image-correct by definition.
Missing/false image registration or byte/hash/geometry/source linkage blocks host readiness separately from model image_suitability claims. A model clear claim cannot cure wrong-image binding.

A patch whose exact raw quote equals its finding anchor must agree with that finding proposed_reading. For broader anchors, host replay must reconcile all supported changes inside the anchor; contradictory finding/patch wording is invalid, never silently preferred.
